response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience in GenAI, cloud-based AI system deployment, vector databases, or RAG architectures — core requirements for the role. While they have broad full-stack experience and some exposure to agentic workflows, there is no evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions or leading technical discovery with enterprise stakeholders in AI/ML contexts.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and developer tooling
Strong background in distributed systems and CI/CD infrastructure
concerns: No clear evidence of GenAI or LLM production deployment experience
Missing direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
Lack of documented leadership in AI technical discovery or enterprise consulting
